name: gateway_congestion
title: The router is struggling
description: Round trips to your own router rise from 3 ms to tens of milliseconds with heavy jitter. The problem is inside the building.

card.title: Your router is slow to respond
card.summary: Round trips to your own router are taking 5 ms with 0 ms of variation. On a healthy home network this is a couple of milliseconds and steady, so something local is loading it up.
remediation: Check whether something on your network is saturating the connection, such as a large upload or a backup.
Power cycle your router: unplug it for 30 seconds, then plug it back in.
Plug in an ethernet cable for anything important in the next few minutes.
